steps.source: ctx => { const i=ctx.steps.host.value,s=ctx.decode(i.value); const a=ctx.decode(ctx.steps.availability.value.wire); return {asOfUtc:new Date(ctx.now).toISOString(),snapshotAgeSeconds:Math.round((ctx.now-s.updated)/1000),quality:i.quality,stale:ctx.now-s.updated>120000,cpuPercent:s.cpu,memoryPercent:s.memory,disks:s.disks,targets:s.targets,availability24h:a.result.map(x=>({job:x.metric.job,instance:x.metric.instance,percent:Number.isFinite(x.samples[0]?.[1])?Math.round(x.samples[0][1]*10000)/100:null})),warnings:a.warnings,limitations:'Scrape availability is not application health. No application event logs or Talia alert records are included.'}; }
